Container.Name: botsu
Container.Overview: Lean self-hosted chat bot for Discord and Fluxer: YouTube upload/live and Twitch live alerts, with moderation and music planned. Replaces Red-DiscordBot without Java/Lavalink. After the first start, fill in the settings file the container creates at /mnt/user/appdata/botsu/botsu.env (Discord/Fluxer tokens, owners, YouTube/Twitch keys); the bot picks it up within 30 seconds. No ports are needed.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database and the settings file botsu.env (created on first start: put your tokens there).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the bot runs as (Unraid default: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the bot runs as (Unraid default: 100 = users).
